kinds.name: Refused
kinds.meaning: masks answered a request with an OAuth error, or the SDK found the answer unusable.
kinds.code: the code masks answered with, or server_error when the answer was not an OAuth error

kinds.name: InvalidToken
kinds.meaning: A token, an ID token, a logout token, or a DPoP proof failed a check in the SDK. missing says the request carried no token at all, and a resource server's challenge then carries no code.
kinds.code: invalid_token for a token, invalid_dpop_proof for a proof

kinds.name: Forbidden
kinds.meaning: The sign-in or token is valid and lacks a scope, a role, or an organization the route needs.

kinds.name: Unavailable
kinds.meaning: masks, its keys, or a store the SDK depends on could not be reached, so nothing can be decided.

kinds.name: Insecure
kinds.meaning: A URL is plain http off this machine, or is not an http or https URL at all.

kinds.name: Foreign
kinds.meaning: A URL belongs to another origin than the one the tokens are held for.

kinds.name: DelegationRefused
kinds.meaning: masks refused a delegation call. sign_in_again says the person has to sign in again, and secret carries a replacement secret when masks rotated it.

kinds.name: DelegationUnavailable
kinds.meaning: masks or the provider did not answer a delegation call. secret carries a replacement secret when masks rotated it before failing.

invalid_request.meaning: The request is missing a parameter, repeats one, or is malformed.

invalid_client.meaning: The client is unknown, or its credentials did not check out.

invalid_grant.meaning: The code, refresh token, or assertion is invalid, expired, revoked, or was issued to another client.

unauthorized_client.meaning: The client may not use this grant type or this endpoint.

unsupported_grant_type.meaning: masks does not support that grant type.

unsupported_response_type.meaning: masks does not support that response type.

invalid_scope.meaning: A scope asked for is unknown, malformed, or more than the client may hold.

access_denied.meaning: The person or masks refused the request.

server_error.meaning: masks failed, or answered with something the SDK could not read.

temporarily_unavailable.meaning: masks, or something the SDK depends on, is not answering for now.

login_required.meaning: Nobody is signed in, and the request asked masks not to prompt.

interaction_required.meaning: masks needs the person to do something, and the request asked it not to prompt.

consent_required.meaning: The person has not allowed this app in, and the request asked masks not to prompt.

invalid_token.meaning: The access token is expired, revoked, malformed, or was issued for another resource.

insufficient_scope.meaning: The token is valid and does not carry a scope the request needs.

insufficient_role.meaning: The sign-in is valid and the person does not hold a role the route needs in the organization signed in to.

insufficient_organization.meaning: The sign-in is valid and names no organization, or another one than the route needs.

invalid_dpop_proof.meaning: The DPoP proof is missing, malformed, signed by the wrong key, made for another request, or used before.

use_dpop_nonce.meaning: The DPoP proof needs the nonce masks sent in the DPoP-Nonce header.

slow_down.meaning: The device is polling faster than masks allows.

authorization_pending.meaning: Nobody has approved the device code yet.

expired_token.meaning: The device code expired before anyone approved it.

invalid_target.meaning: The resource asked for is unknown, or not one the client may reach.

invalid_client_metadata.meaning: A registration names metadata masks refuses.

invalid_request_object.meaning: The request object is malformed or its signature did not check out.

invalid_authorization_details.meaning: The authorization details are malformed or ask for more than the client may hold.

invalid_key.meaning: A key sent to masks is malformed, private, or signs with an algorithm masks refuses.

invalid_audience.meaning: A token names an audience masks does not serve.

invalid_issuer.meaning: The issuer named is unknown, or its discovery document does not describe it.

invalid_state.meaning: The state that came back is not the one this sign-in started with.

invalid_style.meaning: The issuer does not serve avatars in that style.

handshake_required.meaning: This app has not shaken hands with its issuer, so it holds no credentials.

insecure_url.meaning: A URL is plain http off this machine, or is not http or https.

foreign_origin.meaning: A URL belongs to another origin than the one the tokens are held for.

not_a_logout.description: that token is not about a logout

logout_with_nonce.description: that logout token carries a nonce, so it is an ID token

one_proof.description: exactly one DPoP proof is required

proof_not_a_jwt.description: that proof is not a signed JWT

proof_algorithm.description: {algorithm} is not an algorithm a proof may use

proof_no_key.description: a proof carries the public key that signed it

proof_key_unreadable.description: that proof carries a key this API cannot read

proof_unsigned.description: that proof was not signed by the key it carries

proof_other_key.description: that proof was signed by another key than the token is held to

proof_other_token.description: that proof was made for another token

proof_other_method.description: that proof was made for another method

proof_other_url.description: that proof was made for another URL

proof_not_now.description: that proof was not made just now

proof_replayed.description: that proof has already been used

no_privilege.description: this account does not hold the {privilege} privilege

other_organization.description: this sign-in is for {held}, and this needs {wanted}

keys_unreachable.description: {issuer} could not be reached for its keys

replay_store_unreachable.description: the replay store could not be reached

replay_store_answer.description: the replay store answered with something other than true or false

store_unreachable.description: the store could not be reached

not_checked.description: the token could not be checked

plain_http.description: plain http is allowed only on this machine: {url}

not_http.description: {url} is not an http or https URL

other_origin.description: that URL belongs to another origin: {url}

tokens_only_for.description: tokens are held only for {origins}, not {origin}

not_json.description: {url} answered with something other than JSON

not_an_object.description: {url} answered with JSON that is not an object

too_large.description: {url} answered with more than a megabyte

state_mismatch.description: the state did not match the one this sign-in started with

nothing_in_flight.description: this browser has no sign-in in flight

code_expired.description: the code expired before anyone approved it

no_refresh_token.description: there is no refresh token to renew these tokens with

not_held_to_key.description: the token endpoint answered with a token that is not held to this key

not_connected.description: this app has not shaken hands with {issuer}

no_refresh_for_connection.description: masks issued no refresh token to keep the connection with
